response.answer: For discovery with a prospect using generic BI, ask about workflow volume, approval bottlenecks, reporting delays, data quality pain points, integration needs, and executive visibility to connect operational friction to measurable business outcomes. Position Northstar as workflow-aware analytics that complement generic BI by helping operations teams act on workflow issues, not just view dashboards. Emphasize that Northstar connects metrics to approvals, queues, owners, and operational follow-up. Avoid promising guaranteed revenue improvement, replacing all existing systems, meeting every regulatory requirement, or committing to roadmap features. Also, do not share customer names or confidential deal details.
response.rewritten_question: Give me a concise discovery-to-positioning brief for a prospect using generic BI: what should I ask, how should I position Northstar, and which promises must I avoid?

retrieved_chunks.content_preview:
Positioning Against Generic BI Tools

When compared with generic BI tools, position Northstar as workflow-aware analytics. Generic BI tools can report metrics, but Northstar connects metrics to approvals, queues, owners, and operational follow-up.

Approved response: "Northstar complements BI by helping operations teams act on workflow issues, not just view dashboards."

Prohibited Claims

Sales Representatives must not claim that Northstar guarantees revenue improvement, replaces all existing systems, meets every regulatory requirement, or has committed roadmap features. Customer names and confidential deal details should not be shared.

Approved Talk Track

Northstar helps operations leaders see where work slows down, which approvals are delayed, and which data quality issues affect business reporting. Sales Representatives should avoid promising product roadmap commitments.

Discovery Questions

Sales Representatives should ask about workflow volume, approval bottlenecks, reporting delays, data quality pain points, integration needs, and executive visibility. Good discovery connects operational friction to measurable business outcomes.

Positioning Against Workflow Tools

When compared with workflow-only tools, position Northstar as analytics plus process visibility. Workflow tools coordinate tasks, while Northstar tracks patterns, bottlenecks, and KPI impact across workflows.

citations.citation_text: New employees complete onboarding during their first 10 business days. Required onboarding includes security training, benefits enrollment, department orientation, and access review. Managers are responsible for assigning a buddy and scheduling the first 30-day check-in.
citations.source: Source: HR-001 Employee Handbook, Section: Onboarding Basics

citations.citation_text: Vacation is accrued monthly and may be used after the employee's first 30 days of employment.
citations.source: Source: HR-002 PTO and Leave Policy, Section: Vacation Entitlement

response.answer: In the first 10 business days, a new full-time employee must complete onboarding, which includes security training, benefits enrollment, department orientation, and access review. The manager is responsible for assigning a buddy and scheduling the first 30-day check-in. Vacation can first be used after the employee's first 30 days of employment.
response.rewritten_question: For a new full-time employee, what must happen in the first 10 business days, and when can vacation first be used?

retrieved_chunks.content_preview:
Vacation Entitlement

Full-time employees receive 20 paid vacation days per calendar year. Vacation is accrued monthly and may be used after the employee's first 30 days of employment. Part-time employees receive prorated vacation based on scheduled weekly hours.

Employees may carry over up to 5 unused vacation days into the next calendar year. Carried-over days must be used by March 31 or they expire unless local law requires a different outcome.

Vacation Approval Workflow

Vacation requests of 1 to 5 business days should be submitted at least 10 business days in advance. Requests longer than 5 business days should be submitted at least 20 business days in advance.

Managers approve vacation based on business coverage, project deadlines, and fairness across the team. Managers should not deny vacation without explaining the business reason.

Onboarding Basics

New employees complete onboarding during their first 10 business days. Required onboarding includes security training, benefits enrollment, department orientation, and access review. Managers are responsible for assigning a buddy and scheduling the first 30-day check-in.

Employees should complete mandatory security awareness training before accessing customer data or production systems.

Parental Leave Summary

Eligible full-time employees may receive up to 12 weeks of company-supported parental leave after 6 months of service. Local statutory benefits may apply separately. Employees should contact People Operations at least 60 days before the expected leave date when possible.

This document provides a company policy summary and does not provide legal advice.

Sick Leave

Employees receive 8 paid sick days per calendar year. Sick time may be used for personal illness, medical appointments, or short-term caregiving needs. Employees should notify their manager as soon as practical when taking sick leave.

Medical details should not be shared in team channels. People Operations may request documentation only when required by policy or law.

response.answer: For an employee wanting to work from a different Canadian province for 20 business days, the change requires review by People Operations because it exceeds 15 business days. The manager must initially approve the change, considering factors such as team coverage, customer needs, time zone overlap, and data handling requirements. response.rewritten_question: Who needs to review that change, and what should be considered? Context: An employee wants to work from a different Canadian province for 20 business days..

retrieved_chunks.content_preview:
Approval Requirements

Employees must receive manager approval before changing their regular work location. A temporary change within the same country for fewer than 15 business days may be approved by the manager. Longer changes require People Operations review.

Managers should consider team coverage, customer needs, time zone overlap, and data handling requirements before approving remote work.

Cross-Border Work

Northstar does not guarantee approval for work from any country. Temporary cross-border work requires People Operations review before travel. The company does not maintain a formal visa or immigration policy in the employee knowledge base.

Requests to work outside Canada or the United States are considered ambiguous until People Operations reviews tax, employment, and security implications.

Work Model

Northstar supports hybrid work and approved remote work. Employees assigned to Toronto, Montreal, or New York offices are expected to attend office collaboration days when scheduled by their department.

Remote employees may work from approved locations in Canada or the United States if their role, tax location, and security requirements support remote work.

Vacation Approval Workflow

Vacation requests of 1 to 5 business days should be submitted at least 10 business days in advance. Requests longer than 5 business days should be submitted at least 20 business days in advance.

Managers approve vacation based on business coverage, project deadlines, and fairness across the team. Managers should not deny vacation without explaining the business reason.

Not Covered

This policy does not provide legal advice, immigration advice, or guaranteed approval for international remote work.

response.answer: Under the current guide, for an Enterprise SLA miss where Northstar missed a documented SLA and the customer experienced measurable workflow disruption, a Sales Representative may recommend a service credit up to USD 1,000. This credit must be approved by a Manager before it is communicated. Refunds above USD 1,000 require both Manager and Legal review and should not be promised without approval. The previous 2025 support sheet's allowance of a USD 2,500 service credit is obsolete as of the February 15, 2026 guide.

Handoff Rules

When Sales receives a support issue, the Sales Representative should create or link the support case and include customer impact, account tier, urgency, and any promised follow-up. Sales should not run a parallel support process in private notes.

When Support identifies expansion, renewal risk, or contract dissatisfaction, Support should notify the account owner and Manager. The notification should distinguish product issue, adoption issue, billing issue, and contract issue.
